network.vendor: Confirm controller hardware ID before selecting a LAN driver
network.supportNotes: The official revision-specific support pages list Realtek LAN packages. Driver version and OS support must be checked on the matching revision.

audio.vendor: Confirm controller hardware ID before selecting an audio driver

features: Hybrid fan headers and fan stop
AMD Ryzen 3000/4000G/5000/5000G CPU families subject to the revision-specific CPU support list

vendorUtilities.name: GIGABYTE APP Center
vendorUtilities.policy: Offer the official support link; never silently install bundled components.

vendorUtilities.name: EasyTune
vendorUtilities.policy: Informational only. It can expose clock/voltage tuning. No automatic overclocking or voltage changes.

vendorUtilities.name: System Information Viewer / Smart Fan 5
vendorUtilities.policy: Only show when compatible software/hardware is detected. Do not apply fan curves until headers and sensors are mapped.

vendorUtilities.name: Q-Flash / @BIOS
vendorUtilities.policy: Manual vendor workflow only. No automated firmware download, flashing, reboot or downgrade.

safeChecks: Read SMBIOS manufacturer/product, BIOS vendor/version/date, CPU and chipset.
Read network and audio PnP hardware IDs before recommending drivers.
Show current driver versions and compare only against the official page for the confirmed PCB revision and Windows version.
Inspect adapter power-management settings without changing them automatically.
Monitor available temperature sensors and fan readings without changing fan curves.
blockedAutomaticActions: BIOS flash, BIOS downgrade or firmware-region writing
CPU overclock, PBO, voltage, SoC voltage, load-line or memory timing changes
TPM, Secure Boot, SVM, IOMMU, DMA remapping, VBS or HVCI disabling
Bulk changes to chipset, LAN, audio, storage or USB drivers
Disabling Windows Update, Defender, firewall, Store licensing, printing or Search

revisionDetection.preferred: User-confirmed PCB revision printed on the motherboard
revisionDetection.secondary: SMBIOS Win32_BaseBoard.Version, if it exactly matches 1.0, 1.1 or 1.2
revisionDetection.fallback: Generic product support page; do not guess a BIOS revision

notes: The manufacturer provides separate support pages for revisions 1.0, 1.1 and 1.2.
The actual physical revision must be verified before BIOS selection.
Specifications and driver availability can change; refresh official support data before shipping a recommendation.
